author: edwong57
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0006287 base-excision repair, gap-filling.

See https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32760

The reason for obsoletion is that this term was added in error. It is an unnecessary grouping term: every base-excision repair includes gap filling, and the pathway branches by gap length. Annotations can be transferred to the new subtypes from go-ontology#32759 (PR #32765, merged):

- GO:7770137 short-patch base-excision repair
- GO:7770138 long-patch base-excision repair
- or the parent GO:0006284 base-excision repair, if the evidence does not tell the branches apart

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1IHa0Tn96BuvYzwDR3yUQc54mJD_qRqJv3F8gVauYqYA/edit?usp=sharing

### Impacted groups

- MGI: 4 experimental + 3 other. 
- UniProt: 4 experimental. 
- TAIR: 1 experimental. 
- CACAO: 1 experimental.
- Reactome: 12 TAS from 4 pathway mappings. 
- 
** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)

None found. All 85 IEA annotations are phylogenetic projections: Ensembl Compara (GO_REF:0000107, 34) and TreeGrafter (GO_REF:0000118, 51). These will follow the IBA/ortholog decisions. The Reactome pathway-to-GO mappings are listed above.

Thanks.
